kinds.L: Liquid or instant-unstake. Lock inner token/receipt, instant redeem same thing. HyperEVM ticker hPREFIX.
kinds.C1: Long lock / no transferable receipt. Inbound only. Exit is the HyperEVM market. Ticker encodes lock.
kinds.C2: Unstake exists with a known wait. Burn hToken, wait redeemDelay, claim inner on source.

testnet.note: HyperEVM testnet DVNs are only LayerZero Labs + P2P. Do not set the mainnet 2-of-3 ULN on testnet.

listings.name: Hyperleaf sKAITO
listings.claim: owner setClaimTarget each Sign/TokenTable campaign; anyone pokeClaim; then pullYield
listings.note: L redeem returns sKAITO, not KAITO (official unstake is 7d cooldown — protocol never calls it). sKAITO is transferable; Base spot is thin. On HyperEVM hKAITO is also the KAITO spot proxy. BLACKLISTED_ROLE exists; team describes it as investor airdrop exclusion — if the lockbox is ever listed, L redeem can fail. Eco airdrops are per-campaign Sign contracts, often linear vest.

listings.name: Hyperleaf xSQUID
listings.claim: pokeRewards → claimRewards(lockbox, max) selector 0x9a99b4f0 on inner (same address as xSQUID). Then pullYield QUID. Never allowlist inner as pokeClaim target (redeem has same arity).
listings.note: L returns xSQUID. Principal redeem is 1:1 QUID at Squid. Extra QUID is claimRewards, not share-price. Never pull xSQUID.

listings.name: Hyperleaf cbETH
listings.note: Base Coinbase staked ETH. PoS sits in cbETH/ETH rate — never sell inner for HYPE. Redeem same cbETH. Ethereum-mainnet wstETH is a later separate listing.

listings.name: Hyperleaf wstETH
listings.note: Later. Canonical Lido wstETH on Ethereum L1. Do not mix with hcbETH supply.

listings.name: Hyperleaf VIRTUAL MAX
listings.note: Auto Max-lock on Virtuals (104w, autoRenew). Never official redeem. Not 4 years. Yield is agent merkle airdrops (claim(index,account,amount,proof)), not VIRTUAL inflation. v1 harvests Base only, and only when a drop is worth gas+keeper time — 6–7 dust launches/day are skipped, never auto-swapped (honeypot risk). ETH/Arb/Robinhood (4663) claims need the omnichain holder; RH gas makes dust negative EV. Same holder blocker as hKAITO.

listings.name: Hyperliquid BLUAI 4Year
listings.claim: pokeRewards → claimAll() on stake (0xd1058e59). Idle BLUAI in the box is yield; principal stays in stake.
listings.note: C1 until the 4y farm lock ends. No auto-renew. Owner: farmUnstake → restakeIdle (no HyperEVM discount) or setShareExit + dest setRedeemEnabled (arb / buyback). Principal in farm ⇒ reserved 0; after unstake reserved = totalLocked.

listings.name: Hyperleaf sAVAX
listings.note: Testnet script deploys a mock on Base Sepolia until Fuji wiring is used.

listings.name: Hyperleaf ANSEM
listings.note: Watchlist. ansem.io on Solana only — no extra-chain claims. Launch airdrops to $ANSEM holders. Confirm mint before design. Dust+filter like Virtuals, without the holder problem.

listings.name: Hyperleaf veAERO
listings.note: Later. VotingEscrow ERC-721. After hSKY urn lockbox exists we can reuse NFT/position custody patterns. Not next.

listings.name: Hyperleaf stkAAVE
listings.note: HOLD. Do not ship stkAAVE→hAAVE while Safety Module is being replaced by Umbrella. stkAAVE still pays ~150 AAVE/day and still votes, but it is legacy insurance. Tokenizing it is tokenizing governance power (must stay delegated to a protocol address, not follow the hToken) plus duration risk if SM sunsets. If we wrap later: wrap stkAAVE not raw AAVE; never start the 20d cooldown; never slash-aware accounting beyond disclosing max 20% legacy slash. Hyperliquid already has an AAVE perp — confirm a HyperEVM spot gap before building.

listings.name: Hyperleaf sWBERA
listings.note: Official PoL vault, rate grows in WBERA. 7d unbond exists — we never call it; redeem sWBERA. Wait LayerZero Berachain.

listings.name: Hyperleaf AEVO staked
listings.note: sAEVO is NOT an ERC-20 — account stake on AevoStaking. Treat as C1. Rewards/perks often off-chain on the exchange. Confirm a harvestable on-chain reward before build.

listings.name: Hyperleaf staked GMX
listings.note: RewardRouter / esGMX / multiplier points are account-based, not a single receipt. C1 until we map harvest. Arb only for v1.

listings.name: Hyperleaf JupSOL
listings.note: Jupiter LST (rate). If you meant vote-locked JUP instead, that is a different listing. Solana lockbox required.

listings.name: Hyperleaf stDRV
listings.note: Derive stDRV. Instant unstake takes a 20% haircut — we never do that. 28d queue instead. DRV already trades on HyperEVM, so this is low priority (spot exists).

listings.name: Hyperleaf SKY LockStake
listings.note: Flagship financialization listing. Lockstake V2 SKY-only (not MKR). HyperLeaf opens urn 0, lock(), selectFarm(SKY-USDS rewards). V1 never draw/wipe USDS. Vote power stays on a protocol delegate. Ticker is hSKY (claim on the position, not 1:1 SKY). free() burns Sky exit fee — do not advertise 1:1 redeem. No fixed APY. Do not wrap stUSDS. Interface: src/lz/ISkyLockstake.sol. Dedicated OApp next; cannot inherit LeafInboundLockbox (IR stack).

listings.name: Hyperleaf sETHFI
listings.note: ether.fi BoringVault sETHFI. Wrap the receipt, never the raw ETHFI. DelayedWithdraw exists — confirm we never call it (L) vs C2.

listings.name: Hyperleaf SNX
listings.note: Legacy 420 staking retired Jun 2026 (SIP-423). No live SNX yield to wrap. This would only be a HyperEVM spot proxy. Weak listing unless a new stake appears.

listings.name: Hyperleaf DYDX
listings.note: Watchlist. Confirm which receipt (eth DYDX vs dYdX chain stake) before a Kind.

listings.name: Hyperleaf veCRV
listings.note: Same class as veAERO (vote-escrow NFT). Low priority. Do after hveAERO lockbox exists so we reuse it.

listings.name: Hyperleaf SYRUP
listings.note: Maple MIP-019 sunset staking. stSYRUP unstake-only. Lowest priority; yield story is gone.

listings.name: Hyperleaf Aave Umbrella (not AAVE)
listings.note: Not an AAVE wrapper. Umbrella is asset-specific insurance: stake aUSDC/aUSDT/aWETH/GHO, keep Aave supply yield + safety incentives, take that asset's bad-debt slash. A HyperLeaf listing here is a risk-tranche product, not hAAVE. Wait until Umbrella is the settled backstop and we want a specific market (likely GHO or aUSDC), not a ticker for its own sake.
